entries.title: Omwaka alias Guardian Angel v Skysail Mabati Ltd (Civil Case E007 of 2023)
entries.principle: Copyright and related rights are protected under the Copyright Act; infringement attracts remedies including injunctions and damages.

entries.title: City Eye Advertising Agency v Mwenge Miraa Sacco Ltd
entries.principle: Copyright protects original works; infringement requires proof of copying of a substantial part of the protected work.

entries.title: Kenya Copyright Board v Music Copyright Society of Kenya (MCSK) & 2 Others
entries.principle: The regulation of collective management organisations must be transparent and accountable; the Copyright Act governs the licensing and distribution of royalties.

entries.title: Intellectual Property Owners Association v Kenya Copyright Board (KECOBO) & Another
entries.principle: The Kenya Copyright Board's regulatory decisions must be lawful, reasonable and procedurally fair; intellectual property rights are protected under the Constitution and statute.
